description: This header defines the LocalStore class which implements the ILocalStore interface for managing local data storage using SQLite database. It includes method declarations for opening the store, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and removing entries, along with private helper functions and member variables.

classes.name: LocalStore
classes.description: A class that manages local storage operations, including opening connections, creating tables, adding/removing entries, and retrieving data, as defined in the ILocalStore interface.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the database connection to the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the database.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table within a specified range.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.

methods.name: buildGetEventsQuery
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query string to fetch events.
